page.layout: One printed page of text in a single column; at the right edge a partial facing page with cut-off marginal fragments (not transcribed). Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.l: De actis Apostolorum liber est qui historiam à
Luca conscriptam de Apostolorum ministerio, doc-
trina, gestisq; omnibus ad perfectum doctrinæ &
ecclesiasticæ gubernationis exemplar sufficientem
continet. Ex inscriptione. ex 2. Tim 3 10.11.12.
Apocalypsis est liber à Iohanne Apostolo & κατ'
ἐξοχὴν Theologo dicto, conscriptus, qui prophetia
de ijs quæ ipsius seculo, & per omnia secula, præ-
cipuè sub Antichristo ecclesiæ eventura sint, iuxta
Christi ipsius apocalypsin continet. cap.1.cap.vlt.
Dogmatici libri sunt epistolæ ab Apostolis con-
scriptæ, vt doctrinam suam totam, ex ecclesiarum su-
arum circumstantijs omnibus ecclesiæ necessitatibus
applicatam, perfectè literis proprijs consignatam re-
linquerent. Ioa.17.17.20. Eph.3.20.Apo.21. 14. Rom.
Epistolæ sunt Particulares. Ex ordine & inscriptioni-
bus Epist.Pauli & aliorum. Catholicæ.
Particulares sunt quæ particularibus personis
scriptæ fuerunt.
Sunt Ecclesijs particularibus,
aut Personis particularibus.
Ecclesijs particularibus scriptæ sunt à Paulo no-
uem: ad Romanos vna, ad Corinth. duæ, ad Galat.
vna, ad Ephes. vna, Philip. vna, Coloss. vna, Thess. duæ.

page.notes: Marginal fragments on the right facing page are cut off and not transcribed. Greek in the Apocalypsis paragraph is rendered approximately; the bracketed Epistolæ diagram is given as a running sentence where its braces could not be fully resolved. "Philip." is partly illegible in the scan.
